description: This file defines a mock class 'PersistentStoreImplementationMock' for testing purposes, which implements multiple interfaces related to storage operations, notifications, caching, and limits in a persistent store system.

classes.name: PersistentStoreImplementationMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of multiple storage-related interfaces for testing persistent store interactions.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks the registration method for store notifications, both for IStore and IStore2 interfaces.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks the unregistration method for store notifications, both for IStore and IStore2 interfaces.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Mocks setting a key-value pair in the store, with different overloads for namespace and scope.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Mocks retrieving a value from the store, with different overloads for namespace and scope.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Mocks deleting a key from the store for both namespace-based and scope-based keys.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Mocks deleting an entire namespace from the store for both namespace and scope scopes.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Mocks retrieving keys in a scope and namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaces
methods.description: Mocks retrieving namespaces within a scope.

methods.name: GetStorageSizes
methods.description: Mocks retrieving storage size information for a scope.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the storage size limit for a namespace.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Mocks setting the storage size limit for a namespace.
